neutral_facts: The accused, a male, was alleged to have committed a sexual offence against a female victim. The incident occurred approximately three to four months prior to the registration of the FIR on 24 July 2015. The accused claimed to be a juvenile at the time of the incident, but the trial court found the documents supporting this claim to be fabricated. The trial court sought a medical opinion, which concluded the accused was not a juvenile. The High Court initially accepted the plea of juvenility, but the Supreme Court overturned this decision, finding the documents submitted by the accused to be fabricated and manipulated. The Supreme Court concluded that the accused was not a juvenile at the time of the incident.
